inputs.checklistItemText: Transformer pad hot-stick use area (access door side) lacks minimum 10-foot clearance to open area or adjacent building/structure
inputs.question: Are transformer pads shown on the site plan? If so, are their access door orientations indicated, and are there any markings showing the 10-foot clearance zone from the access door?

output.reasoning: The agent is performing a progressive presence and feature-identification check (do transformer pads exist, are door orientations marked, are clearance zones indicated) rather than measuring an actual clearance distance; the 10-foot clearance measurement itself would come in a subsequent question.
